plugin-osm-slot.name: Places
plugin-osm-slot.description: Nearby places with addresses, hours, directions, and a map.

hereApiKey.label: HERE API key
hereApiKey.description: Required for place search and city geocoding. Get a key at developer.here.com.

defaultLat.label: Default latitude
defaultLat.description: Latitude of your default search center.

defaultLon.label: Default longitude
defaultLon.description: Longitude of your default search center.

defaultLocationLabel.label: Default location label
defaultLocationLabel.description: Label in the card header, such as Home or Work.

useBrowserGeolocation.label: Ask browser for precise location
useBrowserGeolocation.description: Show a button to request your live location for nearby results.

defaultRadius.label: Search radius
defaultRadius.description: Maximum nearby distance. Defaults to 10 miles.

resultsCount.label: Results count
resultsCount.description: Number of place cards to show.

customTileUrl.label: Custom map tile URL
customTileUrl.description: Optional raster tile template for the map.

mapAppearance.label: Map appearance
mapAppearance.description: Follow degoog appearance or keep the map light or dark.

useOsmGeocoder.label: Use OpenStreetMap geocoding
useOsmGeocoder.description: Validate locations with Nominatim and use it as a HERE fallback.

nominatimEndpoint.label: Nominatim endpoint
nominatimEndpoint.description: Compatible search endpoint. Public service: one request per second.

debugMode.label: Debug mode
debugMode.description: Log request timing and place-matching diagnostics.

customDarkTileUrl.label: Dark map tile URL
customDarkTileUrl.description: Optional tile template for dark mode.
